description: Digital turbidity probe with temperature output, Modbus RTU over RS-485
source: Acquanativa, Guia de Integração Modbus RTU: Sonda AcquaSensor-TT (web page saved as PDF, 20/02/2026)

sources.title: Guia Técnico: Integração Modbus RTU - AcquaSensor-TT
sources.note: sections 2 and 3, and the request example of section 4

notes: Serial settings from the guide: 9600 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, address 1 (1 to 247). Powered with 12 to 24 V DC, 50 mA typical. Read with function 03.
Floating-point values are IEEE-754 single precision. The guide does not say which word comes first; this map assumes the high word first, so check the first reading against a known value.

The guide also lists a serial number string at 0x0900 (its length is not given) and a calibration coefficient at 0x1100 (written with function 16, its format is not given). Both are left out until the format is known.
The request example of the guide shows the CRC as one byte (4F) and reads four registers from 0x2600 (turbidity and temperature together).
Written from the manufacturer's guide; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Turbidity
registers.description: Wait at least 4 seconds after submerging the probe before reading
